**Psalm 119**  
(All verses 1–176)

1. Happy are those whose ways are blameless, who walk in the law of the Lord.  
2. Happy are those who keep his testimonies, who seek him with their whole heart.  
3. They do no wrong; they walk in his ways.  
4. You have commanded your precepts to be kept diligently.  
5. Oh that my ways may be steadfast in keeping your statutes!  
6. Then I shall not be ashamed, when I look upon all your commandments.  
7. I will give thanks to you with my whole heart; teach me your statutes.  
8. I will keep your statutes; do not forsake me utterly.  
9. How can a young man make his way pure? By guarding it according to your word.  
10. With my whole heart I seek you; let me not stray from your commandments.  
11. I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.  
12. Happy are you, O Lord; teach me your statutes.  
13. With my lips I declare all the judgments of your mouth.  
14. In the way of your testimonies I delight as much as in all riches.  
15. I will meditate on your precepts and consider your ways.  
16. I will delight in your statutes; I will not forget your word.  
17. Deal bountifully with your servant, that I may live and keep your word.  
18. Open my eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of your law.  
19. I am a sojourner on earth; do not hide your commandments from me.  
20. My soul is consumed with longing for your rules at all times.  
21. You rebuke the arrogant, accursed ones, who wander from your commandments.  
22. Remove from me disgrace and contempt, for I have kept your testimonies.  
23. Even though princes sit together and speak against me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.  
24. Your testimonies are my delight and the counselors of my heart.  
25. My soul clings to the dust; give me life according to your word!  
26. I declared my ways, and you answered me; teach me your statutes.  
27. Make me understand the way of your precepts, and I will meditate on your wondrous works.  
28. My soul melts away for sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.  
29. Turn away my eyes from looking at vanities; give me life in your ways.  
30. I have promised by your law in the presence of all your fear.  
31. I have turned my steps to your testimonies; I have not delayed in keeping your commandments.  
32. I have run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.  
33. Teach me, O Lord, the way of your statutes; I will keep it to the end.  
34. Give me understanding, that I may keep your law and observe it with my whole heart.  
35. Lead me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in it.  
36. Turn my heart to your testimonies, not to selfish gain!  
37. Turn my eyes from looking at what is worthless; give me life in your ways.  
38. Establish your word to your servant, to those who fear you.  
39. Take away my disgrace that I endure, for your testimonies are good.  
40. Behold, I long for your commandments; in your righteousness give me life!  
41. Let your steadfast love come to me, O Lord, your salvation, according to your promise.  
42. Then I shall have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.  
43. Let not my tongue forget to praise you, for you have given your blessing.  
44. I keep your law continually, forever and ever.  
45. And I shall walk in a wide place, for I have sought your precepts.  
46. I will speak of your testimonies before kings and shall not be put to shame.  
47. I find my delight in your commandments, which I love.  
48. I will lift up my hands toward your commandments that I love, and I will meditate on your statutes.  
49. Remember your word to your servant, in which you have made me hope.  
50. This is my comfort in my affliction, that your promise gives me life.  
51. The insolent utterly deride me, but I do not turn away from your law.  
52. When I see your commandments, I remember your word.  
53. How beloved are your commandments! I keep them to the end.  
54. How I love your law! It is my meditation all day long.  
55. How precious is your steadfast love, O Lord! Because of this I live.  
56. The proud have smeared me with lies, but I keep your precepts with my whole heart.  
57. I remember your statutes from of old, O Lord, and I have kept them.  
58. My portion is the Lord; I promise to keep your words.  
59. I entreat you with all my heart; be merciful to me according to your promise.  
60. I have considered the way of your testimonies and have kept all your paths.  
61. My steps have been steadfast in your paths; my feet have not slipped.  
62. I have kept your precepts in the midst of my affliction, for you have given me life.  
63. I have loved your commandments above gold, above fine gold.  
64. I have kept your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you.  
65. Let your steadfast love comfort me according to your promise to your servant.  
66. Let your mercy come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.  
67. Let the insolent be put to shame, because they have wronged me with falsehood, but I will meditate on your precepts.  
68. Let those who fear you turn to me, that they may know your testimonies.  
69. My eyes are spent with looking for your promise; I have kept your commandments.  
70. Your testimonies are my heritage forever, and they are the joy of my heart.  
71. I have kept your precepts and your testimonies, for my ways are before you.  
72. May the arrogant be put to shame, for they have twisted the law unjustly. I will meditate on your precepts.  
73. Let those who fear you turn to me, that they may know your testimonies.  
74. May my heart be blameless in your statutes, that I may not be ashamed.  
75. My hope is in your promise; save me according to your word.  
76. My eyes long for your salvation and for the fulfillment of your word.  
77. Let me not be put to shame in waiting for you; may your steadfast love give me life.  
78. Let the arrogant be put to shame, for they have wronged me unjustly. But I will meditate on your precepts.  
79. Let those who fear you turn to me, that they may know your testimonies.  
80. May my heart be blameless in your statutes, that I may not be ashamed.  
81. My soul longs for your salvation; I hope in your word.  
82. My eyes long for your promise; I ask, “When will you comfort me?”  
83. For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke, yet I do not forget your statutes.  
84. How long must your servant endure? When will you punish my persecutors?  
85. The insolent have dug pitfalls for me, contrary to your law.  
86. All your commandments are true; they persecute me with falsehood. Help me!  
87. They had almost made me wander from your law, but I have not forgotten your statutes.  
88. According to your steadfast love, save me; let me live, for your law is my meditation.  
89. The Lord is forever; his word is settled in the heavens.  
90. Your faithfulness endures to all generations; you have established the earth, and it stands firm.  
91. By your appointment they stand this day, for all things are your servants.  
92. If your law had not been my meditation, I should have perished in my affliction.  
93. I will never forget your statutes, for by them you have given me life.  
94. I am yours; save me, for I have sought your precepts.  
95. The wicked lie in wait to destroy me, but I consider your testimonies.  
96. I have seen the end of all perfection, but your commandment is exceedingly broad.  
97. I love your law; it is my meditation all day long.  
98. Your commandment makes me wiser than my enemies, for it is ever with me.  
99. I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.  
100. I understand more than the aged, for I keep your precepts.  
101. I hold back my feet from every evil way, that I may keep your word.  
102. I do not turn aside from your statutes, for you have taught me.  
103. How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!  
104. Through your precepts I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.  
105. Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.  
106. I have sworn an oath and confirmed it, to keep your righteous rules.  
107. I am severely afflicted; give me life, O Lord, according to your word!  
108. Accept my freewill offerings, O Lord, and teach me your statutes.  
109. My soul is always in my hand, yet I do not forget your law.  
110. The wicked have laid a snare for me, but I do not stray from your precepts.  
111. Your testimonies are my inheritance forever, for they are the joy of my heart.  
112. I incline my heart to perform your statutes forever, to the end.  
113. I hate the double-minded, but I love your law.  
114. You are my hiding place and my shield; I hope in your word.  
115. Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.  
116. Uphold me according to your promise, that I may live, and let me not be put to shame in my hope.  
117. Hold me up, that I may keep your statutes forever, and I will preserve them to the end.  
118. You reject all who go astray from your statutes, for their deceitfulness is falsehood.  
119. You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross; therefore I love your testimonies.  
120. My flesh trembles for fear of you, and I am afraid of your judgments.  
121. I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.  
122. Be surety for your servant’s good; let not the arrogant oppress me.  
123. My eyes long for your salvation and for the fulfillment of your righteous promise.  
124. Deal with your servant according to your steadfast love, and teach me your statutes.  
125. I am your servant; give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.  
126. It is time for the Lord to act, for your law has been broken.  
127. Therefore I love your commandments above gold, above fine gold.  
128. Therefore I consider all your precepts to be right; I hate every false way.  
129. Your testimonies are wonderful; therefore my soul keeps them.  
130. The unfolding of your words gives light; it imparts understanding to the simple.  
131. I open my mouth and pant, longing for your commandments.  
132. Turn to me in your steadfast love, according to your promise to your servant.  
133. Let your mercy come to me, that I may live; for your law is my meditation.  
134. Rescue me from my persecutors, and I will keep your precepts.  
135. Let your face shine upon your servant and teach me your statutes.  
136. My eyes run down with tears, because people do not keep your law.  
137. Righteous are you, O Lord, and your laws are right.  
138. Your testimonies you have made known from of old; they are true and enduring.  
139. My zeal wears me out because of your adversaries, for they break your law without fear.  
140. Your promise is very broad, and your law is exceedingly trustworthy.  
141. I am small and despised, yet I do not forget your precepts.  
142. Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and your law is true.  
143. Trouble and anguish have found me out, but your commandments are my delight.  
144. Your testimonies are forever right; give me understanding that I may live.  
145. I call with my whole heart; answer me, O Lord! I will keep your statutes.  
146. I call to you; save me, that I may observe your statutes.  
147. I rise before dawn and cry aloud; I hope in your words.  
148. My eyes are awake before the watches of the night, that I may meditate on your word.  
149. Hear my voice according to your steadfast love; O Lord, give me life.  
150. Those who seek me are near who act according to your law.  
151. Near are your mercies, O Lord, and your law is very trustworthy.  
152. I have had my share of affliction and sorrow, but your commandments are my delight.  
153. My ways are right and blameless; look upon my affliction and rescue me.  
154. Give judgment in my favor and grant me your law as my inheritance.  
155. Far from me are those who do wrong, for I do not forget your law.  
156. Your steadfast love is great; O Lord, give me life according to your justice.  
157. Many are my persecutors and my adversaries, but I do not turn from your testimonies.  
158. I look with awe at the treacherous, for they do not keep your word.  
159. Consider how I love your precepts! Give me life according to your steadfast love.  
160. The sum of your word is truth, and every one of your righteous judgments endures forever.  
161. Rulers have persecuted me without cause, but my heart fears your words.  
162. I rejoice at your word like one who finds great spoil.  
163. I hate and abhor falsehood, but I love your law.  
164. Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous rules.  
165. Great peace have those who love your law; nothing can make them stumble.  
166. I hope for your salvation, O Lord, and I do your commandments.  
167. My soul keeps your testimonies; I love them exceedingly.  
168. I keep your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you.  
169. Let my cry come before you, O Lord; give me understanding according to your word.  
170. Let my plea come before you; deliver me according to your promise.  
171. My lips will utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.  
172. My tongue will speak of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.  
173. Let your hand be with me, for I have chosen your precepts.  
174. I long for your salvation, O Lord, and your law is my meditation.  
175. Let my soul live and praise you, and let your rules help me.  
176. I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek your servant, for I do not forget your commandments.
